items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And I love all the Jo Jones and all the great drummers with the Basie bands.

ctx.x: Do you have a list of must-listen-to drummers for young players?

Well, Mel Lewis is one of my absolute idols. I think he swings. Big band drummers I divide into two categories, Mel Lewis for sure and I love Buddy Rich, I always loved Buddy Rich. He’s like one of the, you know you can pick out the geniuses like Oscar Peterson on the piano and Buddy, like people who do, and Art Tatum, people who could play what nobody will ever be able to duplicate what these people have done, and he’s one of those. I love Jeff Hamilton right now who is a drummer in Los Angeles, one of my…
What’s the IAJE — do they have a mission to increase the audience for jazz as well as the players?
